steps.name: Ingest
steps.means: Triage finds a promise Ben made; master records it as a commitment.

steps.name: Link work
steps.means: A client agent does the work behind the promise.
steps.gate: a task that does the work

steps.name: Deliver
steps.means: Ben delivers; the commitment closes only on evidence he did.

sla.why: an undated promise is due two working days after it was made; a dated commitment's own due date governs on /commitments
